text: Every weekend, millions of people pick a team, wear the armband, and argue about it all week.
Now markets never close. So we asked a simple question. What if stocks were the players?
This is BULL-XI. Fantasy football, for real stocks.
Pick fifteen tokenized stocks with a hundred credits. One tap builds a legal squad.
Not sure what to pick? Auto-pick explains every choice, with real price moves from today and this week.
Choose your starting eleven. Your captain scores double.
Lock it before kickoff. Your squad is sealed inside MagicBlock's private rollup, so rivals can't copy it.
Points come from real price moves. Up one point eight percent is eighteen points, from a time-weighted price written onchain every minute.
At kickoff, MagicBlock's verifiable randomness draws a golden stock. It scores double for everyone who holds it.
A new gameweek starts every hour, and MagicBlock cranks run every step on their own.
Go Pro, and your picks become your investments. Your money is split across your fifteen stocks, kept private in MagicBlock's rollup, and you can sell any time.
Play your friends for a pot. Entry fees sit onchain, and at full time the winner is paid automatically.
At full time, the program scores every squad and commits the result to Solana. Anyone can check it.
No wallet. No fees. Just sign in and play.
BULL-XI. Built on Solana and MagicBlock.
